headline: Honeywell Flour Mills H1 Pre-Tax Profit Surges Over 1,000%
summary: Honeywell Flour Mills Plc reported an 1,115% increase in pre-tax profit to N31.40 billion as revenue rose 41% for the six months ended September 30, 2026.
why: Strong earnings growth from major consumer goods manufacturers highlights shifts in domestic food demand and corporate profitability in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Honeywell Flour Mills Plc
impacts.why: The company reported a massive surge in pre-tax profit and revenue.
